title: Pixel's Optimizations
description: All the performance mods i could find to sqeeze all possible fps out of your pc
body:
## What does this modpack do?

This is a modpack designed to squeeze as much FPS out of YOUR PC. This mod pack has all the optimizations you can think of including **Vulkan mod**, **Entity culling** and **Concurrent Chunk Management Engine** and **MANY others**.

## YOUR PC's GPU OR INTERGRATED GRAPHICS NEED TO SUPPORT VULKAN 1.2 OR NEWER FOR THIS MODPACK TO WORK

## How do i check if my GPU or Intergrated Graphics Support Vulkan?
- Step 1 - Open task manager on windows
- Step 2 - Click on the performance tab
- Step 3 - Click on your GPU (If you have two check your main gpu most of the time its GPU 0)
- Step 4 - Go to https://vulkan.gpuinfo.org/ and input your gpu's name into the box above device
- Step 5 - If the version that shows up is 1.2 or above then your gpu is compatible but if it says a version under 1.2 (ex. 1.1) then your gpu is not compatible. (If it says 1.2 and the mod pack doesnt work try updating your GPU drivers and try again)

## How to i install this?
- Step 1 - Download the modpack
- Step 2 - Download the modrinth app if you havent already
- Step 3 - Open click the modpack file
- Step 4 - Then ur done

## If you are crashing randomly : Remove GPUBooster (or GPU Tape in 1.21.10 and under) since it might be conflicting with Vulkan Mod's rendering

- Step 1 - Go to your Modrinth instance that you have this modpack on
- Step 2 - search for GPUBooster (or GPU tape on 1.21.10 and under)
- Step 3 - Click the trash bin icon next to GPUBooster (or GPU tape on 1.21.10 and under)
- Step 4 - A menu should pop up saying you should create a back up (this is optional) 
- Step 5 - After, press the red "delete 1 project" button and you are done!

## FAQ

Can i add/remove mods?
- Yes, but the the added mods must be compatible with Vulkan Mod (Mods like **Iris Shaders** and **Essentials** that require **OpenGL** will **NOT** work) (Check the full mod list in the Vulkan Mod discord - https://discord.gg/FVXg7AYR2Q)

## Updates

The upkeeping of this modpack depends on the mod creators that create the mods in this modpack. If the mods are not updated by the mod creators i cannot update this modpack or i will create a newer version without the outdated mod
